en.headline: Tsuen Wan street shops to trial dedicated food-waste collection points from September
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department will set up three new collection points serving more than 100 shops selling meat, fruit, vegetables and fish, with bins open daily from 9am to 9pm.
body: The Environmental Protection Department said a six-month food-waste recycling pilot for street-level shops in Tsuen Wan will begin in September. The scheme covers sections of Chuen Lung Street, Ho Pui Street, Yeung Uk Road and the whole of San Tsuen Street, targeting more than 100 businesses that mainly sell meat, fruit, vegetables and fish.

Senior environmental protection officer Mok Yee-ting said the area recorded a low recycling rate between November and January, partly because the existing public collection point at the Luen Yan Street Refuse Collection Point is several blocks away and the previous evening-only opening hours did not match shop operations. Three new points, each with two 120-litre bins, will operate tentatively from 9am to 9pm daily.

Mok said the department does not expect a significant extra burden on the shops because their food waste is relatively simple to separate. Contractors will remove the bins when collecting the waste to maintain hygiene and control odour. Data from the trial will help shape a longer-term strategy for street-shop participation.

zh.headline: 荃灣街舖九月試行廚餘回收點 覆蓋逾百間肉菜魚檔
zh.dek: 環保署將在川龍街、河背街一帶增設三個回收點，每日上午9時至晚上9時開放，服務逾100間街舖。
body: 環境保護署表示，將於九月起在荃灣展開為期六個月的街舖廚餘回收先導計劃，覆蓋川龍街、河背街部分路段、楊屋道及新村街全段，惠及逾100間主要售賣肉類、蔬果及魚類的街舖。
高級環境保護主任莫綺婷指，該區去年11月至今年1月廚餘回收率偏低，原因包括現有聯仁街垃圾收集站的回收點距離較遠，以及以往晚上6時至8時的開放時間未能配合商戶運作。新計劃將增設三個回收點，每個配備兩個120公升回收桶，暫定每日上午9時至晚上9時開放。
莫綺婷表示，由於街舖廚餘種類相對簡單，只要妥善分類，預期不會明顯增加商戶負擔。承辦商收集廚餘時會一併帶走回收桶，以維持衛生及減少氣味。先導計劃收集的數據將有助制訂長遠街舖廚餘回收策略。
